schema.text: Does it seem reasonable that the app asks for your physical activity data?

en.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Does it seem reasonable that the app asks for your physical activity data?

fr.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Vous semble-t-il raisonnable que l’application demande vos données d’activité physique ?

it.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Ti sembra ragionevole che l’app chieda i tuoi dati sull’attività fisica?

de.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Finden Sie es nachvollziehbar, dass die App nach Ihren Daten zur körperlichen Aktivität fragt?

tr.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Uygulamanın fiziksel etkinlik verilerinizi istemesi size makul görünüyor mu?

hu.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Észszerűnek tűnik, hogy az alkalmazás hozzáférést kér a fizikai aktivitási adataihoz?

fa.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: آیا به نظرتان معقول است که برنامه داده‌های فعالیت بدنی شما را درخواست کند؟

ar.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: هل يبدو لك معقولًا أن يطلب التطبيق بيانات نشاطك البدني؟
